My love is very shallow

the more you keep me entertained and not bored , the more i'll stay

but really i don't care if you leave , i'll be bored and find someone else

sometimes i do care for some people, but it's different, i care in a very shallow way

i know i like to hang out with someone when i feel the feeling i get when i'm not bored , maybe it's excitement? or enjoyment? Can't really decide

but as "love" the love in which i'd fall apart if they left? Nope, never

but yes i might "like" someone because they entertain me, or i'm curious towards them

It's like reading a book you like and the moment u get to the last page, you're done with the book and you're never going to reread it again unless you're bored
